articles.title: US stocks: Dow, S&P 500 close at record highs as AI earnings impress, oil prices tumble
articles.description: Stock markets soared to all-time highs on Tuesday, fueled by stellar earnings from corporations. Moreover, the possibility of a peaceful resolution in the Iran conflict greatly enhanced investor optimism. Overall, corporate earnings have been significantly exceeding forecasts this reporting period.
